column2: Turns traction control off. Ride gently on wet or loose ground until you know how it behaves.

column4: Below 3 km/h the motor can start the scooter moving from a standstill as soon as you add throttle.

column2: Turns motor braking off, so your brakes do more of the stopping.

column4: Energy recuperation, that is motor braking, will be turned off, so when stopping your brakes will work more.
